CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2020 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2020 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 2,687 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 7 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: September 2020 to November 2020). These surveys captured 238 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 10 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 809 cards across 70 sites, with 26.9% showing evidence of mouse activity (218 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 253 transects across 59 sites (survey period: September 2020 to December 2020), detecting active burrows in 4% of transects (total: 34 active burrows).
